Photo 0: Faint molded text on the side; capacity marking looks like “120L” (partially readable).

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue plastic water drum with a top cap; no water is visible inside.

risks.risk: Capacity/size may not be exactly what’s molded/partially readable in the photos (e.g., 120L vs another size).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the full molded capacity text on the side (and/or a tape measure photo showing height and diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/most common size shown by the least certain reading (worst-case for buyer value).

risks.risk: Condition risk: hairline cracks, warping, or cap seal issues may not show clearly in these angles.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the drum from all sides plus a close-up of the cap/threads and a quick water-hold test (or at least a dry leak check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-proof (worst case: may need replacement of cap/seal).

risks.risk: The red top cap may be missing/incorrect or not original, affecting usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the cap and its seating/threads, and confirm whether the cap is included and fits properly.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming cap fit/quality is uncertain.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the full molded capacity marking on the drum side (so size is certain).
Close-up of the red cap/threads and how it seals on the lid opening.
Video walk-around showing the entire drum for cracks/repairs, plus a quick leak test or water-hold demonstration.
response.reason: This is a plastic water drum, but there are no provided comparables and the photos only partially confirm the exact capacity and condition details that affect value.
